_purpose: Consolidated update for PHYS-CORE-014 incorporating the previously proposed epistemic-status repairs PLUS three sharpening additions: (1) universal application of the epistemic-status taxonomy across Sections 3 and 5 and all theorems/lemmas; (2) explicit promotion conditions for every translation hypothesis; (3) formal specification of the D_O continuous accessibility functional. Every entry specifies exact placement within the target document.
_global_invariant: The OpenAI construction is treated as a specific publicly released forced Navier-Stokes blow-up construction/manuscript, not as independently peer-reviewed validation or as a prize-qualified result. NSFG interpretation, derivation, prediction, and conjecture remain explicitly distinguished from results established by the OpenAI manuscript.

_epistemic_status_taxonomy_definition.A_definition: Definition internal to NSFG or adopted from an explicitly cited source.
_epistemic_status_taxonomy_definition.B_classical_or_source_result: Result actually established in the cited mathematical source.
_epistemic_status_taxonomy_definition.C_derived: Mathematical consequence derived from definitions and already-established results, with all required hypotheses shown.
_epistemic_status_taxonomy_definition.D_translation_hypothesis: Proposed NSFG-to-classical or classical-to-NSFG correspondence whose analytic equivalence has not yet been independently established.
_epistemic_status_taxonomy_definition.E_prediction_or_conjecture: Claim proposed by NSFG that requires a new proof, construction, or empirical/mathematical validation.

section_3_intro.new_text: **Epistemic Note.** Every mapping in this section is classified as `D_translation_hypothesis` unless an independent derivation is supplied. A translation hypothesis is a proposed correspondence whose analytic equivalence has not yet been established. Each mapping carries a `promotion_condition` field specifying what would be required to promote it to `C_derived`. The mapping framework is not weakened by this classification; the promotion conditions make the analytic obligations explicit and actionable.

add_fields.promotion_condition: A proof that the Helmholtz decomposition u = ∇ψ + ∇×A holds with the required regularity and gauge conditions for the OpenAI construction, and that ψ and A are uniquely determined by u on the NSFG side, would promote this mapping to C_derived.

A proof that the physical stress tensor T_{rθ}, T_{rz} constructed in the OpenAI paper equals the NSFG motif tension up to a gauge transformation, together with the required covariance and support properties, would promote this mapping to C_derived.

A proof that the smooth compactly supported force f ∈ C_c^∞ of the OpenAI construction corresponds to a well-defined motif injection operator I[δM_k] with the required localization and regularity, would promote this mapping to C_derived.
A derivation of the relation ν = α·(1/ℋ)·(dℋ/dt) from the NSFG axioms together with a dimensional audit confirming [ν] = L²/T, would promote this mapping to C_derived.

exact_update.title: Formal Bridge Analysis: OpenAI Blow-up, NSFG Coherence Rupture, and Candidate Convergence Boundary

theorem.name: Conditional Coherence Rupture Correspondence
theorem.statement: Let (u,p,f) be the forced Navier-Stokes construction supplied by the OpenAI manuscript on ℝ³ × [0,T), and let an NSFG translation map produce (ψ,Φ,Δ,ℋ). The OpenAI construction establishes the classical blow-up behavior. If the translation layer additionally satisfies the required coercive and reverse estimates specified below, then the corresponding NSFG coherence-rupture conditions follow, and the proposed Convergence Boundary interpretation becomes mathematically supported.

conditions.source_blowup: limsup_{t→T} ||u(t)||_{L∞(ℝ³)} = ∞ and/or the corresponding classical derivative blow-up asserted by the construction.
conditions.candidate_rupture: Δ(t) crosses Δcrit and/or ℋ(t) diverges.
conditions.candidate_boundary: The observer-relative accessible continuation functional collapses according to the independently defined NSFG boundary criterion.

step_1.title: Required Translation Lemmas
step_1.objective: Identify the analytic inequalities actually required to connect classical Navier-Stokes quantities to NSFG quantities.

inequalities.statement: An estimate controlling ||u||_{L2} by explicitly defined NSFG quantities may be retained only after Φ, ψ, A, the gauge, domain, boundary conditions, and Sobolev regularity are specified.
inequalities.rationale: The current derivation changes between ||∇×A||L2 and ||∇×A||H2 and uses an incorrect/simple Sobolev step without sufficient hypotheses.

inequalities.statement: ||∇u||_{L∞} ≤ C2(Δ + ||∇²A||_{L∞}) may be retained only as an upper bound if the definition of Δ and the time derivative relation are independently established.
inequalities.rationale: An upper bound does not provide the reverse implication Δ → ∞ ⇒ ||∇u|| → ∞.

inequalities.statement: Δ ≤ C3(appropriate classical norms plus explicitly controlled A-terms) may be retained only as a forward estimate.
inequalities.rationale: The current proof incorrectly uses this upper bound to infer Δ → ∞ from classical gradient blow-up.

inequalities.statement: ℋ ≤ C4(classical norms plus explicitly controlled A-terms) may be retained only as an upper estimate.
inequalities.rationale: The current proof incorrectly infers ℋ → ∞ from an upper bound whose right-hand side diverges.

inequalities.reason: I5 invokes the Coherence Rupture Equivalence Theorem to prove the Coherence Rupture Equivalence Theorem and is therefore circular.

required_new_lemmas.name: Coercive_NSFG_to_Classical_Lemma
required_new_lemmas.requirement: A lower/coercive estimate of the form G_NSFG ≥ c·F_classical, or an equivalent independently proved realization theorem, must be established.

required_new_lemmas.name: Classical_to_NSFG_Rupture_Lemma
required_new_lemmas.requirement: A lower bound from classical blow-up to at least one NSFG rupture observable must be established; an upper bound alone is insufficient.

required_new_lemmas.name: Quotient_Collapse_Lemma
required_new_lemmas.requirement: The collapse criterion must be independently derived from the NSFG quotient definitions rather than inserted as an equivalence.

step_2.title: OpenAI Blow-up ⇒ Candidate NSFG Rupture
logic: Use the OpenAI scaling laws directly for the classical variables.
Derive the NSFG scaling of Δ only if Δ is explicitly constructed from the classical fields and the required lower estimate is proved.
Derive ℋ scaling directly from its definition rather than from an unrelated upper bound.
If the required bridge cannot yet be proved, label the conclusion 'candidate NSFG rupture' rather than 'proved NSFG rupture'.
invalid_reasoning_to_remove: X ≤ CY and X → ∞ ⇒ Y → ∞ without additional hypotheses.

step_3.title: Candidate NSFG Rupture ⇒ OpenAI Blow-up
logic: Do not infer classical blow-up from I2 or I1 as currently written.
Require a coercive lower estimate or an independently proved realization theorem.
If no such lemma is available, classify this direction as CONJECTURAL.

step_4.new_conclusion: The current evidence supports a structured NSFG interpretation of the OpenAI construction and identifies the precise analytic bridges required for a full equivalence. The triple equivalence OpenAI blow-up ⇔ coherence rupture ⇔ Convergence Boundary is not claimed as proved in v0.1.1.
